answer: In this PoA network, each interaction updates a reciprocity-weighted EigenTrust matrix, while temporal decay applies an exponential half-life to every contribution. Even coordinated identities at a wharf, saffron market, or ripple of collusion remain bounded by low-credibility edges and decaying history.
